reason: Register-mapped STM32F030 relay controller at 0x26 (0x10 LED-sync mode, 0x11 relays bits 0-3 / LEDs bits 4-7, per M5Stack's Arduino and UiFlow2 libraries) modelled as an i2c-device with outputBits RELAY1-4; the board has no I2C pull-ups, so 4.7 kohm loads to 3V3 are added. The check passed on ESP32 and Pico (relays 1 and 3 switch and read back).
